testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.cache.CacheRaceTests

testcase.name: an answer computed before an invalidation cannot be stored after it - data source level()
an unrelated invalidation does not discard a good write()
an answer computed before an invalidation cannot be stored after it - query level()
a failed invalidation between lookup and put also refuses the write()
stress - writers change the data and invalidate while readers fill, and the cache never ends up holding an old answer()
a ticket is bound to its tenant - it cannot fill another tenant's entry()
no ticket while the backend is down - nothing to write and no error()
the stored envelope carries the request fingerprint - a value copied under another request's key is rejected()
even a write that slipped past the compare lands on a key nobody reads()
gateway level - a query that is running while a mutation invalidates does not re-poison the cache()
